semiconductor_relevance: High — CASTEC specializes in factory automation solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on material handling systems.
summary: CASTEC International Corp. develops and manufactures automation equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in the area of Automatic Material Handling Systems (AMHS). Their products, such as the iTS Series autonomous transport robot, facilitate efficient wafer magazine conveyance in cleanroom environments, enhancing operational efficiency for semiconductor manufacturers.
capabilities: Autonomous transport robots for wafer magazine conveyance

regional_presence.Taiwan: CASTEC is recognized as one of the best performing suppliers in Taiwan, with a stable and growing operation.
